workflow.name: P0 Refactor: AI Capability Layer And Unified Search
workflow.zh_name: P0 重構：AI 能力層與統一搜尋主線
rules: Workbench files are generated convenience views.
REF.4 and REF.5 may overlap after schema boundaries are clear.

expected_outcomes.title: 產品體感
expected_outcomes.body: Keynova 會更像鍵盤優先的工作流 launcher；搜尋結果列負責呈現可執行動作，AI 變成 inline capability，而不是獨立聊天產品。

expected_outcomes.title: UI 結構
expected_outcomes.body: Command Palette 熱路徑會變薄，結果列、動作 chips、preview 與確認流程會逐步分層，讓後續 UI 模擬可以先在 workbench 討論。

expected_outcomes.title: 架構邊界
expected_outcomes.body: UnifiedResult 會成為搜尋、builtin command、file action、AI capability 的共同契約；legacy agent/chat 先保留 fallback，最後在 REF.8 移除。

expected_outcomes.title: 風險控制
expected_outcomes.body: 新流程不應擴大 shell、檔案或網路邊界；高風險操作仍由 backend risk tag 與 UI confirmation 管住。

ui_layout_options.label: 緊湊清單
ui_layout_options.description: 保留目前 launcher 的高速掃描感，結果列最密，preview 只在需要時展開。
ui_layout_options.best_for: REF.2 拆分期間，最不容易造成視覺回歸。
ui_layout_options.tradeoff: 可解釋性較弱，AI action 的狀態需要靠 chip 或狀態列補足。

ui_layout_options.label: 左右預覽
ui_layout_options.description: 左側結果清單，右側顯示 preview、AI 摘要或確認內容。
ui_layout_options.best_for: REF.6 之後，UnifiedResult 與 PreviewPayload 穩定時。
ui_layout_options.tradeoff: 需要仔細控制寬度與鍵盤焦點，避免 launcher 變成重型面板。

ui_layout_options.label: 動作表格
ui_layout_options.description: 每列直接顯示主要 action chips、風險提示與來源 metadata。
ui_layout_options.best_for: 需要比較多個結果和多個可執行動作的 workflow。
ui_layout_options.tradeoff: 資訊密度最高，但若視覺層級沒有壓好會顯得吵。

suggestions.guidance: AI 有新的流程、排版、ADR 或風險建議時，先加到這裡；docs:workbench-sync 會自動渲染到 HTML，使用者勾選後再回寫 Markdown。

questions.title: REF.2 期間要偏向哪種 Command Palette 排版？
questions.help: 這題主要決定 UI mock 的採用方向；正式實作仍以 REF.2 不改行為為前提。

options.label: 緊湊清單
options.impact: 最保守，較不容易打斷 REF.2 拆分與 Bug A/B regression。

options.label: 左右預覽
options.impact: 較接近 REF.6 的目標，但建議先停留在 mock，不急著進 runtime。

options.label: 動作表格
options.impact: 資訊量最高，適合後續 UnifiedResult 穩定後再評估。

questions.title: REF.2 拆分時要優先保護哪些路徑？
questions.help: 可以多選；AI 會依勾選結果安排檢查順序與測試重點。

options.label: Launcher focus / IME
options.impact: 保護 Bug A 類回歸，避免視窗焦點、輸入法、Escape 行為被拆分影響。

options.label: Delete verification
options.impact: 保護 Bug B 類回歸，避免最近刪除、確認流程或狀態重置被拆壞。

options.label: 鍵盤導覽
options.impact: 確保上下選取、Enter、Escape、secondary menu 不因 hook 拆分漂移。

options.label: 視覺 baseline
options.impact: 要求拆分後畫面密度與狀態呈現維持目前使用感。

questions.title: AI 建議要以什麼方式進入正式流程？
questions.help: 這題決定 AI 後續看到 proposal 時的預設處理方式。

options.label: 先更新 HTML 預覽
options.impact: AI 先把想法放進 workbench，讓你勾選確認後再動正式文件。

options.label: 確認後才更新 Markdown
options.impact: 保持 Markdown 權威，避免 AI 建議直接污染 active/current。

options.label: 保留 session log 軌跡
options.impact: 重要決策脈絡進 session log，不塞進 current.md 或 active.md。

suggestion_cards.title: 建議先用保守 UI mock 配合 REF.2
suggestion_cards.body: REF.2 的核心價值是降低 CommandPalette 複雜度，不是改 UI。建議先用緊湊清單做 baseline，再把左右預覽與動作表格留作 REF.6 評估。

suggestion_cards.title: 建議採用 proposal loop
suggestion_cards.body: AI 的新想法先進 workbench-suggestions.json，HTML 自動更新；你勾選後複製 proposal 回對話，AI 再驗證並更新最小 Markdown。

suggestion_cards.title: AI should remind before gated decisions
suggestion_cards.body: When AI detects an ADR direction, task-order change, UI layout choice, safety tradeoff, or other decision-gated change, it should explicitly remind the user to review docs/workbench/tasks.html or give direct approval before implementation continues.

tasks.title: ADR-0029 Decision Lock
tasks.summary: lock ADR-0029 as the governing decision for the AI capability refactor
scope: Create `docs/adr/0029-ai-capability-layer.md` from the plan's ADR draft.
State that AI moves from product core to capability layer.
State that independent chat-first `AiPanel` is removed from the target architecture.
State that autonomous multi-step ReAct is replaced by stateless single-step capability calls.
State that backend approval state becomes UI-owned confirmation over backend risk tags.
Mark ADR-0011, ADR-0016, ADR-0022, ADR-0023, ADR-0024, ADR-0026, and planned ADR-0037 as affected.
non_goals: Do not mark ADR-0029 accepted without developer action.
Do not amend affected ADRs yet; only mark impact.
done_criteria: ADR-0029 exists as proposed/accepted per developer decision.
`docs/decisions.md` references ADR-0029.
Active tasks reflect this plan as P0.

impact.user: 工作方向被鎖定，避免 AI/chat-first 舊路線繼續擴張。
impact.code: 只影響 ADR 與任務文件，不改 runtime code。
impact.risk: 低；主要風險是決策文字和實際任務不同步。

tasks.title: Unified Result Schema
tasks.summary: define `UnifiedResult` as the shared result/action contract
scope: Add backend shared result types for `UnifiedResult`, `ResultSource`, `ActionChip`, `ConfirmRequirement`, `PreviewPayload`, `RankSignals`, and source metadata.
Add matching frontend TypeScript types.
Add conversion shims from existing search, builtin command, and file/action results.
Keep old `SearchResult` and `BuiltinCommandResult` as deprecated compatibility types.
non_goals: Do not delete old result models.
done_criteria: Rust checks and TypeScript checks pass.
Three existing result producers can emit or convert to `UnifiedResult`.
UI scenarios in the design doc are represented by the schema.

impact.user: 所有結果列會逐步走向同一種 action/preview 模型。
impact.code: 建立 Rust 與 TypeScript 的 UnifiedResult 契約，舊型別先保留相容。
impact.risk: 中；schema 若過早定死，後續 REF.6 會卡住。

tasks.title: Command Palette Feature Split
tasks.summary: split `CommandPalette.tsx` into feature-first hooks/components and regression-check Bug A/B paths
scope: Create `src/features/command-palette/`.
Split `CommandPalette.tsx` into feature hooks/components while preserving behavior.
Prioritize `useSearchStream`, `usePipeline`, and `useRecentlyDeleted` because they touch Bug A/B state.
Move `CommandSuggestions`, `FilterChips`, and `SecondaryActionMenu` under the command-palette feature.
Keep shared primitives in `src/shared/components/` only when reused outside the feature.
non_goals: Do not switch to consuming `UnifiedResult`; that waits for `REF.6`.
done_criteria: `CommandPalette.tsx` is under 250 lines.
Extracted hooks have focused tests.
Bug A launcher/focus regression and Bug B delete verification flows are manually checked after the split.
Visual and keyboard behavior match the pre-split baseline.

impact.user: 畫面和鍵盤行為應維持原樣，但後續 UI 改版會更容易。
impact.code: CommandPalette 拆成 feature hooks/components，降低熱路徑檔案大小。
impact.risk: 中；最容易回歸的是 launcher focus/IME 和刪除確認流程。

tasks.title: Agent Handler Module Split
tasks.summary: split `handlers/agent/mod.rs` so lifecycle, local context, tool dispatch, and dev runner stop living in one module
scope: Split `handlers/agent/mod.rs` so lifecycle stays separate from tool dispatch, local context, dev command running, and intent answer helpers.
Move `LocalContextSearcher` to `core/local_context.rs`.
Move dev command runner logic to `core/dev_runner.rs` for later `fix_error` capability use.
Move or isolate risk/safety helpers so `REF.4` can reuse them.
Mark intent-answer modules deprecated where they only support chat-first behavior.
non_goals: Do not change legacy ReAct behavior except where required by safe extraction.
done_criteria: `handlers/agent/mod.rs` is under 600 lines during the observation phase.
Existing agent tests still pass.
Approval state coupling is explicit and isolated.

impact.user: 使用者可見行為應不變，但 agent 相關功能的維護邊界會更清楚。
impact.code: agent handler 拆分 lifecycle、context、tool dispatch、dev runner。
impact.risk: 中高；錯切邊界可能破壞既有 legacy agent fallback。

tasks.title: Stateless AI Capability Layer
tasks.summary: add the stateless AI capability layer for `explain`, `summarize`, and `fix_error`
scope: Add `core/ai_capability/` with a single public call entry.
Add compile-time capability registry, resolver, typed payload/result contracts, and risk tagging.
Implement `explain`, `summarize`, and `fix_error` first.
Add `handlers/ai_capability.rs` IPC entry.
Add frontend `src/features/ai-capability/` hooks and inline UI surfaces.
Preserve prompt audit per call.
non_goals: Do not allow capability functions to call follow-up capabilities.
Do not keep session memory inside capability execution.
done_criteria: Each initial capability has unit and integration coverage.
Inline explain and terminal fix-error scenarios work.
Ollama `qwen2.5:7b` AI inline P50 latency is under 800 ms or the gap is documented before `REF.7`.

impact.user: AI 會變成結果列旁的 explain/summarize/fix_error 動作，而不是獨立聊天面板。
impact.code: 新增 stateless capability layer、IPC handler、前端 inline hooks/surfaces。
impact.risk: 高；需要守住 approval、audit、latency 和 provider 相容性。

tasks.title: Workflow Memory
tasks.summary: add workflow memory as a P0 differentiator, in parallel with `REF.6` prep after the schema boundary is clear
scope: Add knowledge DB schema v4 with `workflow_history`.
Add `core/workflow_memory.rs` with `record` and `suggest` entry points.
Add frontend `src/features/workflow-memory/` for recent workflows.
Use `context_hash` and heuristic ranking before considering embeddings.
non_goals: Do not connect `suggest_next` capability until the capability layer exists.
Do not add broad local-content scanning.
done_criteria: Migration is additive and has rollback guidance.
Recent workflow suggestions work without AI.
Workflow memory gives unified search differentiation without slowing cold open.
notes: May run alongside `REF.4` after `REF.1` schema shape is stable.

impact.user: Keynova 會開始記住近期工作流並提供非 AI 的下一步建議。
impact.code: 新增 workflow_history schema 與 workflow_memory core。
impact.risk: 中高；資料遷移和隱私邊界要非常保守。

tasks.title: Search Box As Pure Dispatcher
tasks.summary: switch the palette result list to consume `UnifiedResult` and remove embedded non-core surfaces from the hot path. **REF.6.A done** (inline AI MVP — `UnifiedResult` wire + `ActionChip` Explain on every row + `Ctrl+E` explain + `InlineCapabilityReply` stream panel); **REF.6.B pending** (remove `AiPanel` / `TerminalPanel` hot-path mount); **REF.6.C pending** (UI approval via `ConfirmRequirement`). See `docs/tasks/refactor-ai-capability.md`
scope: Switch `CommandPalette` result rendering to consume `UnifiedResult`.
Treat `ActionChip` as the first-class action model.
Remove embedded `AiPanel` and `TerminalPanel` mounts from the palette hot path.
Collapse pipeline output to a compact status row.
Make UI approval confirmation read `ConfirmRequirement` and risk tags from results.
non_goals: Do not delete old backend compatibility types yet.
Do not physically remove legacy agent code yet.
done_criteria: UI scenarios 4.1 through 4.5 from the design doc work.
Palette layout stays stable except for explicit preview expansion.
Search, builtin command, file action, note, and model workflows do not regress.

impact.user: 搜尋框會更像純 dispatcher，結果列 action chip 成為主要互動方式。
impact.code: CommandPalette 改吃 UnifiedResult，移除 AiPanel/TerminalPanel 熱路徑掛載。
impact.risk: 高；這是最接近產品手感的切換點。

tasks.title: Quantitative Gates And Legacy Default Off
tasks.summary: add quantitative gates, default `ai.legacy_agent = false`, and observe one release cycle
scope: Add performance bench scripts and CI-friendly file-size gates.
Default `ai.legacy_agent = false`.
Keep legacy agent/chat available behind the flag for one release cycle.
Run manual regression for Bug A/B class race conditions.
Update release notes and docs for the new AI interaction model.
non_goals: Do not physically remove legacy agent/chat code during the observation cycle.
done_criteria: `CommandPalette.tsx` < 250 lines.
`handlers/agent/mod.rs` < 600 lines during observation.
`agent_runtime.rs` < 400 lines during observation or justified pending removal.
AI inline P50 < 800 ms and P95 < 1500 ms.
Palette cold open < 200 ms and warm open < 50 ms.
Search first chunk P50 < 80 ms.
Idle RSS < 150 MB after 10 minutes and < 200 MB after 1 hour, excluding documented budget exceptions.
One release cycle completes without P0 regression reports.

impact.user: 新 AI 互動模型成為預設，legacy agent 只作為 fallback。
impact.code: 加 performance gates，ai.legacy_agent 預設 false，觀察一個 release cycle。
impact.risk: 中；如果量化指標不足，不能急著刪 legacy。

tasks.title: Physical Removal
tasks.summary: after the observation window, physically remove deprecated agent/chat code and legacy flags
scope: Delete chat-first `AiPanel` code and remove palette links to it.
Delete or shrink `agent_runtime.rs` to the remaining archival/audit surface.
Delete migrated `handlers/agent/` legacy content.
Remove `ai.legacy_agent`.
Mark superseded ADRs according to the accepted ADR-0029 outcome.
non_goals: Do not remove audit log tables or historical user data.
done_criteria: Refactor achieves at least 30% code reduction across frontend/backend target files.
Deprecated result and agent code paths are gone.
Documentation and ADR indexes match the final state.

impact.user: 舊 chat-first AI 面板與 ReAct runtime 退出主產品路線。
impact.code: 刪除或大幅縮小 AiPanel、agent_runtime、legacy handler code。
impact.risk: 高；必須確認 audit history 和 fallback 需求已處理。
